description: Main activity class for an Android news reader app, managing layout modes, fragments, action bar setup, and user interactions.

classes.name: NewsReaderActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing news headlines and articles, supporting dual-pane and single-pane layouts, action bar setup, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, finds fragments, determines layout mode, sets up action bar and headlines fragment, restores previous selection.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores category and article selection from saved instance state.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Calls restoreSelection to restore state after activity recreation.

methods.name: setUpActionBar
methods.description: Configures the action bar with tabs or list navigation based on SDK version and parameters.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets default news category on activity start.

methods.name: setNewsCategory
methods.description: Updates UI and fragments to display selected news category.

methods.name: onHeadlineSelected
methods.description: Handles headline selection; updates article fragment or starts ArticleActivity based on layout mode.

methods.name: onCategorySelected
methods.description: Handles category selection from action bar; updates displayed category.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current category and article indices.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles category button click; shows dialog to select category.
